Question: An amusement park has a collection of scale models, with a ratio of \( 1: 20,\) of buildings and other sights from around the country. The height of the United States Capitol is \(289\) feet. What is the height in feet of its replica at this park, rounded to the nearest whole number?
Solution:
The scale \(1:20\) means every model length is one twentieth of the corresponding real length. Thus the replica's height is

\[
\frac{289}{20}=14.45\text{ feet}.
\]

Since \(14.45\) is closer to \(14\) than to \(15\), the rounded height is \(\boxed{14}\) feet, choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
